ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Self-service systems can dispense fuel automatically, but people still decide how to supply each vessel, assist docking, and manage peak traffic.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 100,000 Automotive and Watercraft Service Attendants employed in 2024. Employment is projected to decline to 99,000 by 2034, a net decrease of about 1,000 jobs, with roughly 14,400 openings per year. Median annual pay was about $34,800 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace service attendants, but it will reduce basic roles. Self-service fueling and car washes speed up routine tasks, shifting attendants from operating fuel nozzles toward vessel supply, on-site assistance, equipment maintenance, and customer service. Mechanical service alone faces pressure, while people who can assist effectively on site become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Vessel supply: people assist docking.
On-site assistance: people coordinate the pace.
Equipment maintenance: people investigate abnormalities.
Customer service: people build trust.
Emergency response requires human tradeoffs.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10, low-moderate, reflects exposure in vehicle and watercraft service. Self-service accelerates basic fueling, while people remain responsible for supply and assistance.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure does not mean high risk. Mechanical fueling tasks face replacement, not on-site assistance roles. Attendants who work effectively on site and supply vessels become scarcer as efficiency rises. Roles limited to holding a fuel nozzle face the greatest pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Start in service work and build equipment and on-site skills. Pure fueling roles are shrinking in the AI era, so develop assistance skills early.
Advance from operating a nozzle to managing supplies + maintaining equipment. Learn basic operations and work toward station manager.
Emphasize customer service and on-site experience, and identify the stations where you have worked. Employers value reliability and diligence.
Do not assess candidates only on diligence. Test practical judgment on site. Experienced attendants who can supply vessels justify performance incentives.

ai_s7_trends: Self-service adoption reduces basic roles.
Vessel supply creates opportunities.
Professionals with strong on-site capabilities are in greater demand.

body: Automotive And Watercraft Service Attendants provide basic vehicle and watercraft services, coordinating fueling, tire inflation, washing, care, and supplies. They use equipment and processes to keep customers moving and respond to follow-up needs.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Self-service systems can dispense fuel automatically, but people still decide how to supply each vessel, assist docking, and manage peak traffic.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 自助能自动加，但哪艘船怎么补给、怎么帮靠泊、高峰怎么排，还是人定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年汽车与船艇服务员在岗约 10.00 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 9.90 万人，岗位净减约 0.10 万个，年均产生约 1.44 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.48 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代服务员，但会压缩基础岗。自助加油与自助洗车把常规服务提速，服务员从「握枪加」挪向「船艇补给、现场协助、设备运维、客户服务」。真正被挤掉的是只做机械服务的，有现场力能协助的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 船艇补给：靠泊靠人协。
现场协助：节奏靠人调。
设备运维：异常靠人查。
客户服务：信任靠人建。
突发处置：取舍靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的车船服务区——基础加油被自助加速，但补给与协助还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「机械加油」动作，不是「现场协助」的岗位。有现场力、能补给船艇的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会握枪的服务员。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 服务起步多练设备和现场，AI 时代纯加油在缩，早点练协助。
从「握枪」升级成「做补给 + 管设备」，学运维，争取站长。
突出服务和现场经验，写清跟过哪些站。企业看重稳和勤。
选人别只看勤快，要看有没有现场脑子。能补给船艇的骨干，值得给绩效。

ai_s7_trends: 自助普及，基础岗缩。
船艇补给带来机会。
有现场力的人更抢手。

body: 汽车与船艇服务员主导车辆与船艇基础服务，统筹加油、充气、洗护与补给，运用设备与流程手段，达成出行并跟进需求。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 自助能自动加，但哪艘船怎么补给、怎么帮靠泊、高峰怎么排，还是人定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Software can handle material nesting, but an experienced boilermaker still decides how to make an overhead weld inside a tank without causing a leak.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 10,400 boilermakers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to decline to 10,100 by 2034, a net decrease of about 300 jobs, with approximately 800 openings each year. Median annual pay is about $73,300 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Boilermakers, but it will take over some support work. As material nesting, welding-parameter recommendations, and quality inspection become digital, tradespeople shift from pure physical labor toward high-precision assembly, difficult on-site welding, and safety management. Experienced workers who can deliver safe, high-quality work at height and in confined spaces remain truly scarce.
ai_s2_accel: Predictive replenishment of spare parts and consumables
ai_s2_auto: Automated nesting for cutting and layout
Automated work order and progress scheduling
ai_s3_list: Field welding: machines cannot easily replicate posture and hands-on judgment.
Confined-space and work-at-height operations: people adapt to the environment.
Pressure testing and leak detection: experience identifies anomalies by sound and judgment.
Assembly correction: people adjust accumulated errors.
Final safety responsibility: people must protect high-risk operations.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 3/10 places this occupation in the relatively low AI-exposure range. Core assembly and welding depend on hands-on skill, while only peripheral tasks become digital.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Relatively low exposure is not a reason to stand still. Layout and material cutting are being replaced, not welding and assembly. Technicians who handle difficult welds and manage safety remain scarce, while entry-level workers limited to simple joining face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation at technical school and earn welding and special-operations certifications while enrolled. In the AI era, compete through difficult welding and safety skills, not material handling alone.

Expand from ordinary welding to full pressure-equipment skills, learn assembly and pressure testing, and master collaboration with welding robots to become a safety-focused technician who can lead crews.
Emphasize the materials you have welded, the difficult positions you have handled, and the certifications you hold. Power plant and pressure-vessel experience is an advantage.
Hire for welding ability and certification, not only strength. Technicians who can independently work on pressure equipment merit higher pay.

ai_s7_trends: Welding robots and automated inspection enter standard processes.
Demand for power plant and chemical maintenance remains stable.
Certified technicians with difficult-welding skills are scarcer and more valuable.

body: Boilermakers read drawings to build, install, repair, and dismantle boilers, pressure vessels, storage tanks, and large piping. They assemble, weld, expand tubes, conduct pressure tests, and perform maintenance to keep pressure equipment operating safely at high temperatures and pressures.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Software can handle material nesting, but an experienced boilermaker still decides how to make an overhead weld inside a tank without causing a leak.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 下料排版能交给软件，但「罐里这道仰焊怎么走、怎么不出漏」，还得老师傅上手。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年锅炉制造与安装工在岗约 1.04 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 1.01 万人，岗位净减约 0.03 万个，年均产生约 0.08 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 7.33 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代锅炉制造与安装工，但会接管部分辅助。下料排版、焊接参数推荐和质检交给数字化后，技工从「纯体力」挪向「高精度装配、现场疑难焊接与安全管理」。真正稀缺的是能在密闭高空把活干漂亮、干安全的老师傅。
ai_s2_accel: 焊接机器人的协同作业
备件与耗材的预测补给
ai_s2_auto: 下料与排版的自动套料
工单与进度的自动排程
ai_s3_list: 现场焊接：姿态与手感机器难复制。
密闭高空作业：环境靠人适应。
试压排漏：异常靠经验听判。
装配纠偏：累积误差靠人调。
安全兜底：高危作业要人守。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 3/10 说明这个职业处在低 AI 曝光区——核心装配焊接靠手上功夫，只有边角被数字化。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 低曝光也别躺平：被替代的是「排版和下料」，不是「焊和装」。会高难焊接、能管安全的技师永远缺。怕的是只做最简单拼接的初级工。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 去技校打底，在校把焊工证和特种作业证考了。AI 时代拼的是高难焊接和安全，别只做搬运工。
从普通焊扩到承压设备全技能，学装配与试压，把机器人协同用熟，升级成能带班的安全技师。
突出你焊过什么材质、上过什么高难、持什么证。有电站和容器经验优先。
招人看焊接水平和持证，不止看力气。能独立干承压设备的技师值得给高薪。

ai_s7_trends: 焊接机器人与自动检测进标准工序。
电站与化工检修需求稳定。
持证高难技师更稀缺更值钱。

body: 锅炉制造与安装工按图纸建造、安装、维修和拆除锅炉、压力容器、储罐及大型管道，进行装配、焊接、胀接、试压与检修，保障承压设备在高温高压下的安全运行。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 下料排版能交给软件，但「罐里这道仰焊怎么走、怎么不出漏」，还得老师傅上手。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can calculate area, optimize material layouts, and prepare quotes, but the quality of a curved cut around a corner and the evenness of the stretched carpet still depend on the installer's hands and eyes at floor level.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 20,300 Carpet Installers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to fall to 18,300 by 2034, a net decrease of about 2,000 jobs, with approximately 1,100 openings each year. Median annual pay is about $49,900 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Carpet Installers, but it will take over measurement, material layout, and quoting. Mobile measurement apps and intelligent layout software are already in use. Installation is hands-on site work: carpet cannot install itself, and machines and algorithms cannot replace the craft of stretching, seaming, and finishing edges.
ai_s2_accel: Prefabricated carpet modules reduce on-site joining
Online video training in installation techniques
ai_s2_auto: Mobile measurement and automated area calculation
Software-optimized material layouts and cutting plans
Digital construction photos and acceptance records
ai_s3_list: Precision cutting for corners, door frames, and stairs
Stretching technique that keeps carpet flat and free of bubbles
Seaming that produces flat, nearly invisible joins
On-site judgment because subfloor conditions determine preparation
Stamina and patience for a full day of kneeling
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 3/10 places this role in the relatively low AI exposure tier. Automation is concentrated in measurement, material layout, and quoting, while installation itself is a hands-on on-site craft. As long as physical carpet must be installed on physical floors, installers have work.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low exposure does not mean no change. Tools are becoming smarter, and prefabricated and modular flooring is increasing. Installers who read plans, use measurement tools, and handle large commercial projects are more competitive than those limited to residential work.

ai_s5_persona.建议: The low education requirement can suit a student who dislikes academic study but is skilled with their hands, although the physical cost to the knees must be clear. Learn under an experienced installer for two years before considering independent work because craft is the foundation of this career.

Master commercial projects such as hotels, offices, and exhibition venues, and use measurement and layout tools to improve efficiency. Protect your knees with proper equipment and less uninterrupted kneeling. Build referrals from established clients to secure work in peak seasons.

People with carpentry, renovation, or flooring experience transition fastest because the tools and physical demands are similar. Try an apprenticeship first instead of immediately buying a large collection of tools.

Skilled installers are consistently hard to recruit. Retain them with guaranteed pay + piece rates + good tools. Providing quality stretchers and cutters improves productivity and keeps quotes competitive.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Minimizing waste when cutting rolled material
Stretch carpet tightly and remove wrinkles

ai_s7_trends: Measurement, material layout, and quoting are becoming fully digital, helping installers work more efficiently.
Commercial spaces and prefabricated modular flooring provide stable demand.
Skilled installers are scarce, and those with strong technique and reputations command clear premiums.

body: Carpet Installers lay carpet in residential and commercial spaces. They measure sites, cut and join materials, secure flooring, stretch carpet, treat seams, and finish baseboards and edges so the result is flat, attractive, well-fitted, and durable.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can calculate area, optimize material layouts, and prepare quotes, but the quality of a curved cut around a corner and the evenness of the stretched carpet still depend on the installer's hands and eyes at floor level.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能帮你算面积、排料、出报价，但墙角那道弧线裁得好不好、地毯绷得平不平，还得靠安装工跪在地上的手和眼睛。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年地毯安装工在岗约 2.03 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 1.83 万人，岗位净减约 0.20 万个，年均产生约 0.11 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.99 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代地毯安装工，但会接管测量、排料和报价：手机测量 App、智能排料软件已经在用。铺装是「现场手工活」，地毯不会自己铺自己，拉伸、接缝、收边这些手艺，机器和算法替不了。
ai_s2_accel: AR 辅助预览铺设效果
预制模块地毯减少现场拼接
自动裁切设备提高下料精度
安装工艺的在线视频培训
ai_s2_auto: 手机测量与面积自动计算
排料与裁剪方案的软件优化
报价单与预约管理自动化
施工照片与验收记录电子化
ai_s3_list: 异形裁剪：墙角、门框、楼梯的精准贴合。
拉伸手艺：让地毯平整不鼓包。
接缝处理：烫缝平整、肉眼难辨。
现场判断：地面状况决定预处理方式。
体力与耐性：跪地一天的持久战。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 3/10 说明这行的自动化集中在「测量、排料、报价」这些前后端环节，真正铺装过程是纯手工的现场手艺；只要还需要真实的地毯铺在真实的地板上，安装工就有活干。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 低曝光不等于没变化：工具在变聪明，预制和模块化地材在增加，会看图纸、会用测量工具、能接商用大单的师傅比只会铺住宅的更有竞争力。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 学历要求低，适合不爱读书但手巧的孩子，但膝盖是硬成本，要提前讲清楚。建议先跟师傅学两年再考虑单干，手艺是这行的本钱。
把商用项目的手艺练精（酒店、办公、展馆），学用测量和排料工具提效。注意保护膝盖，用护具、减少连续跪地；积累老客户转介绍，旺季就有保障。
有木工、装修、地板安装经验的转行最快，工具和体力都是相通的。先做学徒试水，别一上来就买一大车工具。
师傅难招是常态，用「保底 + 计件 + 工具配置」留人。给师傅配好的拉伸器和裁切工具，效率上来了，报价才有竞争力。

ai_s7_trends: 测量、排料、报价全面数字化，师傅用软件提效。
商用空间与预制模块地材带来稳定需求。
手艺型师傅稀缺，技术口碑好的人溢价明显。

body: 地毯安装工负责在住宅和商业空间铺设地毯，包括测量场地、裁剪拼接、铺装固定、张力拉伸、接缝处理与踢脚线收边，保证地毯平整美观、贴合耐用。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能帮你算面积、排料、出报价，但墙角那道弧线裁得好不好、地毯绷得平不平，还得靠安装工跪在地上的手和眼睛。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Cooking robots can reproduce standard dishes, but when a guest asks for less spice, extra scallions, or a last-minute change in preparation, a cook still has to step in.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 1.4602 million Cooks, Restaurant were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 1.6772 million by 2034, a net increase of about 217,000 jobs, with about 250,700 openings annually. The median annual wage was about $36,800 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Cooks, Restaurant, but it will take over some standardized tasks. Automated ordering, inventory management, and cooking robots handle prep work and standard dishes, shifting cooks' time from repetitive cooking to signature dishes, flavor innovation, and quality control. The truly scarce professionals are skilled cooks who can define a restaurant's taste.
ai_s2_accel: Image-recognition spot checks for food quality
Supply chain coordination and purchasing optimization
ai_s2_auto: Automated ordering and kitchen display systems (KDS)
Automated recipe, nutrition, and cost calculations
ai_s3_list: Intuition for heat and seasoning: machines struggle to reproduce an experienced cook's touch.
Last-minute changes: human judgment is needed when guests make unexpected requests.
Signature dish innovation: people create distinctive flavors.
On-site food safety judgment: experience helps identify abnormalities.
Keeping the team on pace: people steady the kitchen during rush periods.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 indicates low-moderate AI exposure: core cooking depends on touch and experience, while only standardized peripheral tasks are digitized.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure is no reason to stand still: fixed actions are replaceable, not flavor. Cooks who create signature dishes and lead a kitchen remain in demand. The risk is knowing only how to follow recipes without learning new dishes.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation at a reputable culinary school and practice knife skills and flavor profiles extensively. In the AI era, craftsmanship and creativity matter, so do not settle for assembly-line cooking.
Progress from following recipes to developing signature dishes. Learn cost control and food safety, aim to become a head cook, and move beyond repetitive tasks.
Highlight the stations you have worked, the cuisines you have cooked, and the rushes you have handled. Signature dishes and experience leading a line are advantages.
Do not hire on speed alone; assess consistency and command of flavor profiles. Cooks who can develop dishes and lead a kitchen justify higher pay.

ai_s7_trends: Cooking robots are entering standardized chain operations, automating standard dishes.
Central-kitchen preparation plus in-store reheating is becoming mainstream.
Cooks with signature techniques and product-development skills are becoming more valuable.

body: Cooks, Restaurant prepare ingredients, cook and season food, plate dishes, and coordinate service in food establishments. They control taste and food safety and keep supply aligned with front-of-house demand as frontline members of the kitchen production team.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Cooking robots can reproduce standard dishes, but when a guest asks for less spice, extra scallions, or a last-minute change in preparation, a cook still has to step in.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 炒菜机器人能复刻固定菜品，但「客人说少辣多葱、临时改做法」，还得厨师上手。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年餐厅厨师在岗约 146.02 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 167.72 万人，净增约 21.70 万个岗位，年均产生约 25.07 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.68 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代餐厅厨师，但会接管部分标准化动作。自动点单、库存管理、炒菜机器人接走了备料和固定菜品，厨师的时间从「重复炒」挪向「招牌菜、调味创新和品质把控」。真正稀缺的是有手艺、能撑起一家店味道的人。
ai_s2_accel: 出品质量的图像识别抽检
供应链协同与采购优化
ai_s2_auto: 自动点单与厨显系统 KDS
库存与订货的自动提醒
固定菜品的炒菜机器人复热
配方与营养成本的自动核算
ai_s3_list: 火候与调味直觉：机器难复制老师傅的手感。
临场改做法：客人临时要求靠人应变。
招牌菜创新：味道的差异化靠人。
食品安全现场判断：异常靠经验发现。
团队带节奏：高峰期稳场靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光区——核心烹饪靠手感和经验，标准化边角才被数字化。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光也别躺平：被替代的是「固定动作」，不是「味道」。会做招牌菜、能带后厨的人永远缺。怕的是只会照方炒、不学新菜。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 去正规厨校打底，在校多练刀工和味型。AI 时代拼的是手艺和创新能力，别只当流水线炒锅。
从「照方炒」升级成「能研发招牌菜」，学成本和食品安全，争取升厨师长，别停留在重复动作。
突出你站过什么灶、做过什么菜系、扛过多高峰。有招牌菜和带线经验优先。
招人别只看速度，要看稳定性和味型把控。能研发和带后厨的厨师值得给更高薪。

ai_s7_trends: 炒菜机器人进连锁标准化，固定菜品无人化。
中央厨房预制 + 门店复热成主流。
有招牌手艺和研发能力的厨师更值钱。

body: 餐厅厨师在餐饮门店负责食材准备、烹饪调味、菜品装盘与出餐，把控口味与食品安全，配合前厅节奏稳定供应，是后厨出品的一线执行者。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 炒菜机器人能复刻固定菜品，但「客人说少辣多葱、临时改做法」，还得厨师上手。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can schedule classes and generate reports instantly, but school administrators still need to address teachers' frustrations and parents' anxiety face to face.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 333,300 Education Administrators, Kindergarten Through Secondary were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to decline to 328,100 by 2034, a net decrease of about 5,200 jobs, with about 20,800 openings each year. Median annual pay was about $104,100 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace school administrators, but it will change how they work. Systems increasingly handle schedules, reports, and data summaries. Administrators can shift from processing transactions to making decisions and leading teams. Teacher management, family communication, and crisis response remain human responsibilities. Leaders who can manage people and use data become more resilient.
ai_s2_accel: AI analysis of student performance for instructional decisions
Intelligent scheduling to optimize classrooms and staffing
Wider use of online family communication platforms
AI alerts for academic and mental health risks
ai_s2_auto: Automated creation and adjustment of class schedules
Digital management of official documents and records
ai_s3_list: Teacher management and motivation: leadership depends on trust that algorithms cannot calculate.
Human connection in family communication: administrators must understand parental anxiety and explain decisions clearly.
Crisis response and decisions: public scrutiny and safety incidents require judgment in the moment.
Understanding education: teaching and development take time and cannot be managed by data alone.
Responsibility and accountability: student safety requires people to protect firm boundaries.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 places this occupation in the moderate AI exposure range. Systems can handle much of the routine work, including schedules, reports, and statistics.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not mean high risk. AI takes over administrative transactions, while people retain management responsibilities. Team leadership, communication, and decisions become more important. Purely transactional roles contract, while administrators who can lead teams and understand education gain value.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Teacher education or educational administration is a direct path. Build classroom experience as a teacher, then strengthen both instructional and communication skills. Management can follow naturally from that foundation.

Use data analysis and educational technology tools, and volunteer to coordinate teaching projects. Advance from transaction processing to decisions and team leadership, and pursue the required principal qualification.

Education values frontline experience. Career changers can start in administration or academic affairs at a private school. Describe the teams you led, incidents you handled, and projects you delivered.
Do not assess administrators only by degrees and titles. Evaluate team leadership and crisis response. Leaders who enable teachers to teach confidently and earn parents' trust are the scarcest.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Flag academic and mental health risks

ai_s7_trends: As educational technology spreads, administrators are shifting from schedules and reports to data-informed decisions and team leadership. Digital literacy is becoming a core skill.

Changes in student enrollment and teacher demographics are shifting management toward faculty development and personalized education. Administrators who understand how education works are in greater demand.
Family-school collaboration is becoming routine, making communication and crisis response central management skills.

body: Primary and secondary school and kindergarten administrators manage daily operations and instruction, including curricula and teaching plans, staffing and training, student and classroom affairs, family communication, campus safety, and administrative budgets.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can schedule classes and generate reports instantly, but school administrators still need to address teachers' frustrations and parents' anxiety face to face.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能自动排课、秒出报表，但老师心里的委屈、家长眼里的焦虑，还得你去面对面化解。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年教育行政管理者、幼儿园中等教育在岗约 33.33 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 32.81 万人，岗位净减约 0.52 万个，年均产生约 2.08 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 10.41 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代学校管理者，但会改变工作方式。排课、报表、数据统计正被系统接管，管理者从「事务处理」转向「决策+带队伍」——教师管理、家校沟通、危机处理，是机器替代不了的。会带队伍、懂数据的管理者反而更稳。
ai_s2_accel: AI 分析学情辅助教学决策
智能排课优化教室与师资
在线家长沟通平台普及
AI 预警学生学业与心理风险
ai_s2_auto: 排课与调课系统自动生成
报表与数据统计自动化
公文与档案电子化管理
考勤与设备管理数字化
ai_s3_list: 教师管理与激励：带队伍靠人心，算法算不出。
家校沟通的温度：家长焦虑要接得住、讲得清。
危机处理与决策：舆情、安全突发，临场拍板。
教育规律的把握：教学与成长是慢功夫，不能只盯数据。
责任与担当：学生安全无小事，底线靠人守住。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业有一半的事务性工作正被自动化——排课、报表、统计，系统都能帮上忙。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。AI 接管的是「事务」环节，留下的是「管理」环节——带队伍、沟通、决策反而更重要。真正被压缩的是纯事务型岗位，会带队伍、懂教育的管理者更值钱。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 师范或教育管理专业是正路，先做教师积累一线经验。把教学和沟通能力都练起来，管理是水到渠成的事。
把数据分析与教育信息化工具用起来，主动承担教研和项目统筹。从「事务管理」升级为「决策+带队伍」，考校长任职资格。
教育行业讲究一线经验，跨行可从民办学校行政或教务管理切入。简历多写「带过什么团队、处理过什么事件、推进过什么项目」。
招管理者别只看学历和头衔，要看带队伍和危机处理能力。能让老师安心教书、让家长放心的管理者，是最稀缺的。

ai_s7_trends: 教育数字化普及，管理者从「排课报表」转向「数据决策+带队伍」，信息素养成为基本功。
生源与教师结构变化，管理重心转向师资培养与个性化教育，懂教育规律的管理者更抢手。
家校共育常态化，沟通与危机处理能力成为管理者的核心竞争力。

body: 中小学与幼儿园教育行政管理者负责学校日常运营与教学管理，包括课程与教学计划安排、师资配置与培训、学生与班级事务、家校沟通、校园安全及行政预算。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能自动排课、秒出报表，但老师心里的委屈、家长眼里的焦虑，还得你去面对面化解。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Automated feeders can dispense feed on schedule, but workers still notice when an animal looks unwell or a pond lacks enough dissolved oxygen.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 224,600 Farmworkers, Farm, Ranch, and Aquacultural Animals were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 213,400 by 2034, a net decrease of about 11,200 jobs, with about 31,200 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $36,200 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace livestock and aquaculture workers, but it will assist large-scale operations. Automated feeding, environmental monitoring, and disease recognition accelerate repetitive work. Workers shift from pure physical labor to observation, data recording, and disease prevention. People who only dispense feed face the greatest pressure, while those who monitor animals and prevent disease gain value.
ai_s3_list: Health observation: people assess condition.
Early disease detection: people recognize abnormalities.
Birth assistance and care: people protect live animals.
On-site emergency response: people handle unexpected events.
Environmental judgment: people apply experience.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 3/10 places this frontline occupation in the relatively low AI-exposure tier. Feeding and cleaning still rely heavily on people, while systems mainly handle monitoring and records.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low exposure does not mean no change. Basic feeding and recordkeeping are being replaced, not the work of observing animals and preventing disease. As operations scale, workers skilled in animal observation and disease prevention gain value. People who only dispense feed face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation at an agricultural vocational school and study disease prevention and data. Basic feeding work is declining in the AI era, so develop observation skills early.
Advance from dispensing feed to animal care, disease prevention, and data work. Learn to use environmental and disease-monitoring tools.
Emphasize experience at livestock or aquaculture operations and give specific disease-prevention examples. State which animal species you have worked with.
Do not select workers only for strength. Assess whether they can observe signs of disease. Workers who prevent illness are worth retaining.

ai_s7_trends: Automated feeding is spreading across large-scale livestock operations.
AI disease recognition is in its early stages.
Workers who can observe animals and prevent disease are in greater demand.

body: Farmworkers, Farm, Ranch, And Aquacultural Animals raise livestock, poultry, and aquatic animals. They feed and clean, assist births, prevent disease, perform routine health checks, record growth, and protect animal health and market readiness at livestock operations and aquaculture sites.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Automated feeders can dispense feed on schedule, but workers still notice when an animal looks unwell or a pond lacks enough dissolved oxygen.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 自动饲喂机能定时投料，但哪头牲口今天不对劲、塘里溶氧够不够，还是工人一眼看出来的。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年农场工人、农场、牧场、动物在岗约 22.46 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 21.34 万人，岗位净减约 1.12 万个，年均产生约 3.12 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.62 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代养殖工人，但会辅助规模化。自动饲喂、环境监控、疫病识别把重复工作提速，工人从「纯体力」挪向「观察判断 + 数据记录 + 疫病防控」。真正被挤掉的是只做基础投喂的人，会看牲口能防疫的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 健康观察：状态靠人看。
疫病早判：异常靠人辨。
接产护理：活体靠人护。
现场应急：突发靠人处。
环境判断：经验靠人定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 3/10 说明这个职业处在低 AI 曝光的一线区——饲喂清洁大量人工，系统只管监测与记录。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 低曝光不等于没变化：被替代的是「基础投喂与记录」动作，不是「观察防疫」的岗位。会看牲口、能防疫的人反而随规模化更吃香。怕的是只会机械投料的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 农职校打底，多学防疫与数据。AI 时代纯投喂在缩，早点练观察。
从「投料」升级成「看管 + 防疫 + 数据」，学环境和疫病工具。
突出养殖场经验和防疫案例，写清跟过哪些畜种。
选人别只看力气，看会不会观察疫病。能防病的工人值得留。

ai_s7_trends: 规模化养殖，自动饲喂普及。
疫病识别 AI 起步。
会观察能防疫的工人更抢手。

body: 农场、牧场及水产养殖动物工人负责饲养畜禽与水产活体，进行喂食清洁、防疫接产与日常健康检查，记录生长并在养殖场与水域现场保障动物健康与出栏。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 自动饲喂机能定时投料，但哪头牲口今天不对劲、塘里溶氧够不够，还是工人一眼看出来的。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can optimize schedules and predict visitor peaks, but you still need to step forward when guests are angry about waiting in heavy rain.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), employment of First Line Supervisors Of Entertainment And Recreation Workers, Except Gambling Services is projected to rise from about 123,300 in 2024 to 131,100 in 2034. That is a net increase of about 7,800 jobs, with roughly 13,400 openings each year. The median annual wage is about $46,900 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace entertainment and recreation supervisors, but it will change their priorities. Systems take over scheduling, reports, and attendance forecasts. Supervisors shift from spreadsheets to field coordination, team management, and guest experience. These depend on human judgment and communication. Administrative-only roles face pressure, while supervisors who lead people and handle incidents become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: Smart inspections link to security alerts
ai_s3_list: Field coordination and response: experience guides temporary staffing and venue changes when attendance shifts or equipment fails.
Complaint and dispute resolution: calm emotions, propose solutions, and turn an angry guest into a returning one.
Team management and training: judgment matters when new employees struggle and experienced staff resist direction.
Final responsibility for safety: the on-site supervisor is accountable for crowd safety during peaks.
Business interpretation of operating data: systems provide figures, but supervisors decide staffing and schedules.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 places this career in the moderate exposure range. Systems automate much of the desk work, including scheduling, reports, and attendance forecasts.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not mean high career risk. AI replaces calculation, while management remains. Field coordination, team leadership, and guest experience become more important. Spreadsheet-only supervisors face pressure. Supervisors who lead people, handle incidents, and understand operations become more valuable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Formal education requirements are limited. Study tourism, sports operations, or hospitality management, then intern at theme parks or venues. Focus on operating data, safety standards, and team management.

Use attendance forecasts, scheduling systems, and performance platforms. Volunteer for complaint resolution and training. Move from spreadsheet supervisor to business-minded supervisor, then pursue operations management.

Front-line service is the fastest entry path, with strong performers often competing for lead roles within about a year. On your resume, state team size, incidents handled, and peak-season operating results.
Do not select supervisors on tenure alone. Assess coordination and response ability. Candidates who handle visitor peaks, lead teams, and understand data offer more value than tenure by itself.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Schedule staff automatically from attendance forecasts
Route complaints and close the follow-up loop
Ticket checks, capacity controls, and data analysis
Attendance, space productivity, and cost analysis

ai_s7_trends: Scheduling and attendance forecasts become intelligent. Supervisors move from spreadsheets to guest experience and team leadership, making operational data skill a new requirement.
Experience-driven spending continues to expand. Theme parks and venues add content and service, sustaining demand for front-line managers.
Safety and compliance standards tighten, increasing demand for supervisors who understand emergency response and safety rules.

body: First Line Supervisors Of Entertainment And Recreation Workers, Except Gambling Services direct front-line service staff at theme parks, sports venues, cinemas, and similar facilities. They manage schedules, service quality, site order, and safety incidents while connecting employees with operations management.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can optimize schedules and predict visitor peaks, but you still need to step forward when guests are angry about waiting in heavy rain.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能算出最优排班、预测客流高峰，但游客在暴雨里排队骂街的那一刻，站出来稳住场面的还得是你。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年主管工人在岗约 12.33 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 13.11 万人，净增约 0.78 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.34 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.69 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代娱乐休闲主管，但会改变工作重心。排班、报表、客流预测这些桌面活被系统接手，主管从「做表格」里解放出来，转向现场调度、团队管理和体验保障——这些靠人的判断和沟通，机器替代不了。真正被压缩的是纯行政型主管，会管人、会处置的主管更值钱。
ai_s2_accel: AI 客流预测辅助人员排布
智能巡检与安防联动预警
投诉工单智能分流处理
员工绩效数据平台化考核
ai_s2_auto: 排班与考勤系统自动化
运营报表与数据统计自动生成
客流预测与票务系统联动
库存与耗材管理电子化
ai_s3_list: 现场调度与应变：客流突变、设备故障，怎么临时调人调场，靠经验。
投诉与纠纷处理：安抚情绪、给出方案，把「气走了」变成「下次还来」。
团队管理与带教：新人带不动、老员工难管，分寸感是核心。
安全责任的兜底：高峰期的人流安全，最终由现场主管担责。
运营数据的业务解读：系统给数据，怎么用人、怎么排班，主管来定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业有一半桌面任务正被自动化——排班、报表、客流预测都有系统代劳。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。AI 替代的是「算」的部分，留下的是「管」的部分——现场调度、团队管理和体验保障反而更重要。真正被挤压的是只会填表排班的主管，会管人、会处置、懂运营的主管更值钱。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 学历要求不高，适合先读文旅、体育运营或酒店管理相关专业，再进主题公园和场馆实习。重点学运营数据、安全规范和团队管理。
把客流预测、排班系统和绩效平台用起来，主动承担投诉处置和带教。从「做表格的主管」升级为「会经营的主管」，向运营经理走。
从一线服务岗切入最快，半年到一年可竞聘领班。简历上多写「管理过多少人、处理过什么突发、旺季运营数据」。
招主管别只看「干得久」，要看调度和处置能力。能扛客流高峰、会带团队、懂数据的候选人，比老资历更有价值。

ai_s7_trends: 排班与客流预测智能化，主管从「做表格」转向「管体验、管团队」，运营数据能力成为新要求。
体验消费持续扩张，主题公园与场馆向「内容+服务」升级，一线管理岗位需求稳定。
安全与合规要求趋严，会应急处置、懂安全规范的主管更吃香。

body: 娱乐与休闲一线主管负责监督和调度主题公园、体育场馆、影院等场所的一线服务人员，管理排班、服务质量、现场秩序与安全事件，是连接一线员工与运营管理层的基层管理者。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能算出最优排班、预测客流高峰，但游客在暴雨里排队骂街的那一刻，站出来稳住场面的还得是你。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Systems can schedule and issue warnings, but supervisors still decide how to assign crews, lead repairs, and respond to emergencies.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 617,500 First Line Supervisors Of Mechanics, Installers, And Repairers employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 636,500 by 2034, a net increase of about 19,000 jobs, with roughly 52,400 openings each year. The median annual wage is about $78,300 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace maintenance supervisors, but it will reduce routine scheduling and diagnostics. Predictive maintenance and remote diagnostics accelerate normal work orders, shifting supervisors from dispatch toward emergency repair leadership, on-site decisions, and team development. Pure dispatch roles face pressure, while technical leaders remain stable.
ai_s3_list: On-site leadership: people lead the crew.
Emergency decisions: people make tradeoffs.
Safety control: people protect the boundary.
Skill transfer: people train apprentices.
Client communication: people coordinate expectations.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 places this career in the moderate AI exposure range. Systems accelerate some workflows, while people retain judgment and responsibility for exceptions.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not mean high risk. Systems replace scheduling and dispatch actions, not emergency repair leadership and decisions. Technically skilled leaders become scarcer as efficiency improves.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build technical and leadership skills from an electrical or mechanical foundation. Pure dispatch work is shrinking in the AI era, so practice directing crews early.
Advance from repairing equipment toward leadership and decisions. Learn management and safety.
Highlight technical and shift-lead experience. Owners value reliability and composure under pressure.
Do not select people only for technical skill. Assess their on-site authority and leadership; strong crew leaders deserve team responsibility.

ai_s7_trends: Predictive maintenance expands, reducing manual dispatch.
On-site leadership creates opportunities.
Supervisors who make strong decisions remain more stable.

body: First Line Supervisors Of Mechanics, Installers, And Repairers lead maintenance crews on site. They coordinate work orders, safety, and spare parts, applying technical and interpersonal skills to complete emergency repairs and deliver reliable equipment service.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Systems can schedule and issue warnings, but supervisors still decide how to assign crews, lead repairs, and respond to emergencies.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 系统能排程预警，但怎么派、怎么带、突发怎么决，还是主管定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年主管修理在岗约 61.75 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 63.65 万人，净增约 1.90 万个岗位，年均产生约 5.24 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 7.83 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代维修主管，但会压缩排程与诊断。预测性维护与远程诊断把常规排程提速，主管从「派工」挪向「带人抢修、现场决断、班组培养」。真正被挤掉的是纯派单，懂技术、能带人的人更稳。
ai_s3_list: 现场带人：班组靠人带。
突发决断：取舍靠人。
安全把关：底线靠人。
技能传授：徒弟靠人带。
客户沟通：协调靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业处在中等 AI 曝光区——部分环节被系统加速，但真正要人判断与兜底的地方还留着位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「排程派单」动作，不是「带人抢修与决断」的岗位。有技术、能带人的人，反而随提效更稀缺。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 机电起步多练技术和带人，AI 时代纯派单在缩，早点练指挥。
从「会修」升级成「会带 + 决断」，学管理与安全。
突出技术与带班经验，业主看重稳和扛。
选人别只看技术，看压场和带人，骨干值得给班组。

ai_s7_trends: 预测维护普及，派单缩。
现场带人带来机会。
能决断的主管更稳。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can reduce fingerprint matching from days to minutes, but people still decide which hair at a scene deserves collection and defend conclusions under courtroom questioning.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 20,700 Forensic Science Technicians employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 23,300 by 2034, adding about 2,600 jobs and producing roughly 2,900 openings each year. Median annual pay is about $67,400 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Forensic Science Technicians, but it will change how they work. AI is taking over fingerprint matching, database screening, and report drafts. Technicians are shifting from operators to professional evaluators. Crime-scene examination, evidence collection, result interpretation, and courtroom testimony still require human judgment. Technicians who use AI screening can work more efficiently.
ai_s2_auto: Electronic evidence registration and chain-of-custody management
ai_s3_list: Crime-scene judgment: deciding which traces matter and which are contamination or noise.
Evidence collection technique: preventing contamination and preserving chain of custody, where details determine admissibility.
Result interpretation: instruments produce data, while people identify error, interference, and defensible conclusions.
Courtroom testimony: explaining technical findings clearly and responding to cross-examination.
Rigor and confidentiality: following procedure and producing reproducible conclusions are professional obligations.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 6/10 means AI is accelerating more than half of comparison and screening tasks. Machines process fingerprints, DNA, and spectral libraries faster than people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not equal high risk. AI handles screening, while professional judgment remains essential in scene examination, evidence collection, interpretation, and testimony. Roles limited to routine comparison face pressure. Technicians who interpret findings and testify carry more value.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study forensic science, criminalistics, chemistry, or biology, and prioritize laboratory courses and internships. Develop both instrument skills and technical writing, and prepare for the emotional demands of the work.

Use AI comparison and database tools, pursue the relevant forensic examiner credential, and specialize in fields such as DNA or toxicology. Move from routine operation toward professional judgment and expert testimony.

A chemistry or biology background can lead to laboratory roles at forensic institutions. Public security roles require a competitive recruitment examination. On your resume, name the tests you performed, reports you issued, and courtroom experience you gained.

Do not assess candidates by education alone. Evaluate procedural discipline and performance under pressure. Technicians who collect evidence correctly, interpret results, and withstand courtroom questioning are scarce.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Rapid comparison across large fingerprint databases
Composition analysis of fibers, glass, and other materials

ai_s7_trends: AI comparison and screening are becoming standard. Technicians are moving from manual comparison toward screening plus expert interpretation, making database skills essential.
Forensic services are becoming more standardized and market-based. Credential requirements are rising, and technicians who testify and accept professional responsibility are in stronger demand.
Emerging contaminants, novel drugs, and digital evidence are increasing demand for technicians with cross-disciplinary expertise.

body: Forensic Science Technicians collect and test physical evidence in criminal and civil cases. Their work includes scene documentation; recovery of biological, chemical, and physical samples; and laboratory analysis of DNA, fingerprints, toxicants, and impression evidence.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can reduce fingerprint matching from days to minutes, but people still decide which hair at a scene deserves collection and defend conclusions under courtroom questioning.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能把指纹比对从几天缩到几分钟，但现场哪根毛发值得提取、结论怎么扛住法庭质询，还得靠你。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年法医科学技术员在岗约 2.07 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 2.33 万人，净增约 0.26 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.29 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.74 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代法医科学技术员，但会改变工作方式。指纹比对、数据库筛查、报告初稿正被 AI 接管，技术员从「操作员」转向「专业判断者」——现场勘查、检材提取、结果解读和出庭陈述，是机器替代不了的。会利用 AI 筛查的技术员反而更高效。
ai_s2_accel: AI 辅助血迹形态与弹道分析
质谱数据自动谱库匹配
现场影像自动重建与标注
语音转写辅助出庭笔录
ai_s2_auto: 指纹与足迹自动比对筛查
检材登记与链管理电子化
鉴定报告初稿自动生成
ai_s3_list: 现场勘查判断：哪些痕迹值得提、哪些是干扰项。
检材提取手艺：防污染、保链完整，细节决定证据效力。
结果解读：仪器给数据，人给结论，误差与干扰靠人辨识。
出庭陈述：把技术语言讲给法庭听，扛住质询。
严谨与保密：流程合规、结论可复核，职业底线。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业有超过一半的比对筛查任务正被 AI 加速——指纹、DNA、谱库，机器都比人快。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。AI 接管的是「筛查」环节，留下的是「专业判断」环节——现场勘查、检材提取、结果解读和出庭陈述反而更重要。真正被压缩的是纯比对操作岗，会解读、能出庭的技术员更值钱。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 选法医学、刑事科学技术、化学或生物专业，重视实验课和实习。把仪器操作和文书能力都练起来，心理承受力也要提前练。
把 AI 比对和数据库工具用起来，主动考司法鉴定人资格，往 DNA、毒物等专科方向深耕。从「操作员」升级为「专业判断者+出庭专家」。
化学、生物背景可切入司法鉴定机构的检验岗位，公安系统需通过招录考试。简历多写「做过哪些检验项目、出过哪些报告、是否出庭过」。
招技术员别只看学历，要看流程严谨度和抗压能力。能规范提取、能解读结果、又能出庭扛住质询的候选人，是最稀缺的组合。

ai_s7_trends: AI 比对与筛查普及，技术员从「人工比对」转向「筛查+专业解读」，数据库能力成为基本功。
司法鉴定规范化与市场化并行，资质要求提高，会出庭、能担责的技术员更抢手。
新污染物、新型毒品与电子物证增多，跨学科复合技术员需求上升。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Models can generate maps automatically, but Geographers still decide which questions to ask, how to interpret results, and how conclusions should be used.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 1,500 workers in 2024, projected to remain at about 1,500 by 2034. That is a net gain of about 0 jobs, with roughly 100 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $97,200 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Geographers, but it will reduce routine map production. Remote sensing and GIS accelerate standard cartography, shifting work toward problem design, model interpretation, and field validation. People limited to mapmaking face displacement, while those who design studies and explain findings become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Problem design: people decide what to ask.
Model interpretation: people determine meaning.
Field validation: people verify real conditions.
Cross-disciplinary judgment: people exercise discretion.
Policy translation: people turn evidence into action.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 7/10 score places this occupation in a moderate-high AI exposure range. Map production and analysis are accelerating, but people retain responsibility for research design and interpretation.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not equal high risk. AI replaces standard mapmaking tasks, not roles centered on problem design and interpretation. As data expands, people who can design studies and explain findings become scarcer and more valuable. The vulnerable position is map production alone.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build geographic science foundations through modeling and writing practice. Pure cartography is shrinking in the AI era, so develop research design skills early.
Progress from map production to problem design and interpretation, and learn remote-sensing models.
Emphasize your specialization and publications, and clearly describe the regions and projects you have studied.
Do not assess candidates only by software proficiency. Evaluate whether they can design research questions, and give strong contributors opportunities to lead projects.

ai_s7_trends: Remote-sensing models are becoming widespread.
Cross-disciplinary demand is increasing.
People who can interpret findings are in greater demand.

body: Geographers study spatial patterns on Earth's surface and relationships between people and the environment. They use remote sensing, GIS, and field surveys to analyze environmental and regional processes and provide spatial evidence for planning, environmental protection, and policy.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代地理学家，但会压缩常规成图。遥感与 GIS 把标准制图提速，工作从「画地图」挪向「问题设计、模型解释、田野验证」。真正被挤掉的是只做制图的人，会设计会解释的人更值钱。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Diagnostic tools can identify a fault first, but technicians still determine which hose leaks, how to replace it, and how to restore equipment in the field.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 188,700 mobile heavy-equipment mechanics in 2024, projected to rise to 199,600 by 2034. That is a net increase of about 10,900 jobs, with roughly 16,500 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $64,000 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace heavy-equipment technicians, but it will reduce routine labor hours. Remote diagnostics accelerate standard faults, shifting repair from repeated testing toward precise assembly replacement, field maintenance, and emergency repair. Standard-parts replacement faces pressure, while hydraulic and nonstandard expertise becomes more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Field troubleshooting: people judge nonstandard faults.
Hydraulic work: people rely on feel.
Emergency repair decisions require human tradeoffs.
Field support: people adapt to conditions.
Experience transfer: people teach hands-on judgment.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 4/10 score places this occupation in a low-moderate AI exposure range. Diagnosis accelerates, but people still perform field disassembly and hydraulic work under complex operating conditions.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure brings change. Standard-parts replacement is replaceable, not field emergency repair. Technicians skilled in hydraulics and field work become scarcer with infrastructure demand. Manual-only parts replacers face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Begin in construction machinery and practice hydraulics and diagnostics. Pure parts replacement is shrinking in the AI era, so develop system-level skills early.
Advance from parts replacement to diagnosis plus maintenance and learn diagnostic tools and calibration.
Highlight equipment models and field experience and identify the machinery you supported.
Do not hire only for speed. Assess hydraulic diagnostic ability. Strong field technicians justify allowances.

ai_s7_trends: Widespread adoption of digital diagnostics.
Infrastructure and mining sustain demand.
Hydraulic expertise is in greater demand.

body: Mobile Heavy Equipment Service Technicians repair construction machinery and mining mobile equipment, diagnose hydraulic and powertrain faults, replace assemblies, restore operating capability, and document repairs on work orders.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代重型设备技师，但会压缩常规工时。远程诊断把标准故障提速，维修从「反复试」挪向「精准换总、现场保养、应急抢修」。真正被挤掉的是只会换标准件的人，懂液压与非标的人更值钱。

野外保障：条件靠人。

基建矿山维持需求。
懂液压的人更抢手。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can identify fault codes, but repairers still need hands to open the housing and find the failed component.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 37,300 home appliance repairers employed in 2024, projected to reach 38,300 by 2034. That is a net increase of about 1,000 jobs, with roughly 3,100 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $49,400 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace home appliance repairers, but it will change diagnosis. AI diagnostics, remote self-tests, and repair knowledge bases will locate problems faster than experience and circuit diagrams alone. After diagnosis, people must disassemble, test, solder, replace parts, reassemble, and run the appliance. AI and robots cannot soon perform these field tasks. Value shifts from knowing what failed toward being able to repair it.
ai_s2_accel: Remote self-testing and reporting by smart appliances
AR repair guidance overlays operating steps
ai_s2_auto: Remote fault-code reading and initial diagnosis
Repair knowledge bases and case search
ai_s3_list: Hands-on repair: skilled disassembly, soldering, and component replacement.
Difficult fault judgment: intermittent and soft faults require logic and experience.
Field communication: explain causes, quotations, and warranties to customers.
Safety standards: control electrical, flammable-refrigerant, and elevated-work risks.
Adaptability: apply professional temporary measures when parts are unavailable.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 4/10 score reflects growing AI involvement in diagnosis and information, while physical craft limits actual replacement of repair work.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure still brings change. AI expands the number of people who can identify faults, lowering the value of diagnosis alone. The durable advantage is fast, high-quality repair. Skilled technicians handling difficult faults and earning strong customer reviews become easier to trust as information grows transparent.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Home appliance repair is a trade that gains value with experience, and vocational electrical or electronics education provides a path. Build foundations in circuits, refrigeration, and soldering, then join brand service or a platform and earn refrigeration and electrician credentials while working.

Specialize in premium appliances, commercial kitchen equipment, or smart-home repair, where one job can equal several ordinary appliances. Use AI diagnostics to work faster and complete more calls each day.

People with electrical, electronics, or refrigeration knowledge transition fastest. Bring examples of independent repairs and customer-review screenshots to interviews, which can persuade more than certificates. Learn standardized processes through a platform or service network first.

Do not treat technicians as parts replacers; strong repairers build reputation. Base pay on diagnosis plus craft, provide room for difficult cases and technical training, and stable skilled technicians will reduce platform complaints.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Search fault cases by appliance model
Compare prices, order, and arrange delivery

ai_s7_trends: AI diagnostics and intelligent self-tests speed fault location and shift repair toward hands-on craft.
Demand grows for premium-appliance and smart-home repair, while replacement purchases reduce ordinary-appliance repair volume.
Platform-based service becomes dominant, with technician reputation and ratings determining order volume.

body: Home appliance repairers diagnose and repair refrigerators, washing machines, air conditioners, stoves, and other household appliances. They inspect on site or in shops, disassemble and repair equipment, replace parts, verify operation, and advise on maintenance and use.

ai_s3_list: 动手维修：拆装、焊接、换件的熟练手艺。
疑难故障判断：偶发故障、软故障要靠逻辑与经验。
现场沟通：向客户讲清故障原因、报价与保修。
安全规范：带电、易燃冷媒、高空作业的风险控制。
变通能力：配件缺货时用专业方式临时处理。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明诊断与信息环节的 AI 接触面在增大，但维修工作是体力加手艺，AI 实际替代比例有限。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于零变化：AI 让「会查故障的人」变多了，也就压低了纯诊断的价值。真正的护城河是修得又快又好——手上有活、能处理疑难故障、客户口碑好的师傅，反而因为信息透明而更容易被信任。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 家电维修是「越老越吃香」的手艺岗，技校电子电工专业就有出路。在校把电路、制冷、焊接基础打牢，毕业进品牌售后或平台，边干边考制冷与电工证。
往高端家电、商用厨电、智能家居设备修方向走，这些设备修一台顶好几台普通家电。把 AI 诊断工具用起来，诊断更快，一天能多跑几单。
有电工、电子、制冷基础的人转型最快。求职时带上独立修好的案例和客户好评截图，比证书更有说服力，先跟平台或售后学规范流程。
别把师傅当「换件工」用，好师傅修的是口碑。按「诊断 + 手艺」定报酬，给疑难故障和技术培训留出空间，师傅稳定了，平台投诉率才下得来。

ai_s7_trends: AI 诊断与智能自检普及，故障定位更快，维修重心转向手艺。
高端家电与智能家居维修需求增长，普通家电维修量受换新挤压。
平台化服务成为主流，师傅口碑与星级决定订单量。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can clearly arrange the work in the warehouse, but the skills of backing the forklift into the narrow aisle and loading the goods onto the high-level shelves require the driver to operate it from the driver's seat.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that there will be approximately 792,500 industrial truck operators on the job in 2024, and this number is expected to rise to 801,600 by 2034, with a net increase of approximately 9,100 jobs, an average annual vacancy of approximately 76,400, and a median annual salary of approximately US$46,400 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace industrial truck operators, but it will change the way warehouses operate: AGVs replace manual handling in standard aisles and repetitive routes, the dispatching system automatically assigns tasks, and the operator's role shifts to "driving scenes that cannot be managed by AGVs + knowing how to operate the system." Flexible loading and unloading, special-shaped goods, and on-site judgment will still rely on people in the short term.
ai_s2_accel: AGV automatic guided vehicles undertake fixed route transportation
Linkage between WMS system and vehicle-mounted terminal improves efficiency
Safety warning system prompts blind spots and collision risks
Collaboration between Gaocha and automated three-dimensional library
ai_s2_auto: Warehousing system automatically allocates storage locations
Automatic recording of inbound and outbound data
Automatic collection of vehicle operation data
ai_s3_list: Driving skills: Precise operation of narrow aisles and high shelves.
On-site judgment: instant assessment of cargo center of gravity and stacking stability.
Safety instinct: Anticipation of blind spots, pedestrians, and cargo dumping.
Documents and system operations: keep up with the pace of the warehousing system.
Abnormal handling: on-site handling of vehicle breakdowns and damaged goods.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 3/10 shows that the core of this industry is driving and on-site operations. AGVs can replace standard scenarios, but flexible loading and unloading and exception handling still rely on people. The low score is because the "physical attributes" of the job are strong, and it will take a long time for AI and robots to cover all warehousing scenarios.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low exposure does not mean there is no change: AGVs and automated three-dimensional warehouses are becoming more popular, and positions that purely "open fixed lines" will be replaced. Operators who can drive high-speed forks, understand WMS, and can manage AGVs are more popular. Technology is addition, not subtraction - provided you are willing to learn.

ai_s5_persona.建议: For children who don’t want to go to college, getting a forklift license and entering warehousing and logistics is a low-threshold option. Remind your children to ingrain safety regulations into their bones, learn some WMS and forklift maintenance skills, and move towards the direction of Gao Cha and team leader.

Don't stop at "opening a flat fork", learn advanced forks, take more advanced certificates, and supplement WMS system operation and AGV management. People with good safety records and a wide range of skills will have an advantage during busy seasons and transition periods.

Taking the forklift license exam is the fastest way to change careers, with a short cycle and high demand. Give priority to regular warehousing and logistics companies, and ask about social security and piece-rate rules; develop in the direction of team leader and dispatch after having warehouse experience.

Forklift drivers are highly mobile, so use "busy season subsidies + safety rewards + skill promotion" to retain them; drivers who can drive high-speed forks, understand the system, and have a safety record are worthy of higher wages.

High-tech and WMS system skills have become core competitiveness, and hybrid operators are popular.
Digitalization of warehousing safety (early warning systems, data monitoring) has become the industry standard.

body: Industrial truck operators operate industrial vehicles such as forklifts, tractors, and stackers to load, unload, transport, stack, and transfer goods in warehouses, factories, and distribution centers. They are key operational positions in the warehousing and logistics system that connect the previous and the next.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能把仓库里的活儿排得明明白白，但叉车倒进窄通道、把货码上高层货架的那一手技术，还得驾驶员在驾驶座上操作。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年工业卡车操作员在岗约 79.25 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 80.16 万人，净增约 0.91 万个岗位，年均产生约 7.64 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.64 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代工业卡车操作员，但会改变仓库的作业方式：AGV 在标准通道和重复路线上替代人工搬运，调度系统自动分配任务，操作员的角色转向「开 AGV 管不了的场景 + 会系统操作」。灵活装卸、异形货物、现场判断，这些短期内仍靠人。
ai_s2_accel: AGV 自动导引车承担固定路线搬运
WMS 系统与车载终端联动提高效率
安全预警系统提示盲区与碰撞风险

ai_s3_list: 驾驶技术：窄通道、高货架的精准操作。
现场判断：货物重心、堆叠稳定性的即时评估。
安全本能：盲区、行人、货物倾倒的预判。
单据与系统操作：跟得上仓储系统的节奏。
异常处置：车辆故障、货物破损的现场处理。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 3/10 说明这行核心是驾驶与现场操作，AGV 能替代标准场景，但灵活装卸和异常处理仍靠人；评分低是因为岗位的「物理属性」强，AI 和机器人要覆盖全部仓储场景还需要很长时间。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 低曝光不等于没变化：AGV 和自动化立体库在普及，纯「开固定线路」的岗位会被替代，会开高叉、懂 WMS、能管 AGV 的操作员更吃香。技术是加法，不是减法——前提是你愿意学。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 不想读大学的孩子，考个叉车证进仓储物流是低门槛选择。提醒孩子把安全规程刻进骨子里，再学点 WMS 和叉车维护技能，往高叉和组长方向走。
别停在「开平叉」，学高叉、考更高级证书，把 WMS 系统操作和 AGV 管理补起来。安全记录好、技能全的人，在忙季和转型期都有优势。
考叉车证是最快的转行路径，周期短、需求大。优先选正规仓储物流企业，问清社保和计件规则；有仓库经验后往组长、调度方向发展。
叉车司机流动性大，用「忙季补贴 + 安全奖励 + 技能晋升」留人；能开高叉、懂系统、安全记录好的司机，值得给更高工资。

ai_s7_trends: AGV 与自动化立体库普及，标准搬运场景的岗位被替代。
高叉与 WMS 系统技能成为核心竞争力，复合型操作员吃香。
仓储安全数字化（预警系统、数据监控）成为行业标配。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can flag suspected cracks among a stack of radiographs in seconds, but a testing specialist must rescan with the probe to decide whether an indication is a true defect or a normal geometric reflection before issuing and signing the report.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 67,300 nondestructive testing specialists employed in 2024, projected to rise to 68,300 by 2034. That is a net increase of about 1,000 jobs, with roughly 5,700 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $77,400 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI is changing nondestructive testing, but by assisting interpretation rather than replacing testing specialists. Automated radiograph interpretation quickly flags suspected defects and relieves specialists from fatiguing visual review. However, defect characterization, procedure development, standards application, and signing responsibility still require certified specialists. For complex structures and high-temperature, high-pressure equipment, the risk of AI misses means people must provide the final safeguard.
ai_s2_accel: Automated scanning and imaging with phased-array ultrasonics (PAUT)
Industrial CT providing three-dimensional internal inspection of components
Drones and robots carrying inspection equipment into hazardous areas
ai_s2_auto: AI-assisted radiograph interpretation automatically flags suspected defect regions
Automated generation of testing data and report templates
Digital storage and comparison of radiographic films
Digital testing schedules and equipment management
ai_s3_list: Defect characterization: people confirm whether an AI-flagged region is a real defect.
Procedure development: applying standards to different materials, thicknesses, and welds.
Signing responsibility: judgments affecting equipment and personal safety behind each report.
Complex field response: adapting inspections in elevated, confined, and high-temperature environments.
Standards and regulations: continual learning as industry standards evolve.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 6/10 score means AI is taking over much of this occupation's interpretation work. Automated radiograph review and defect recognition reduce low-level repetitive judgment, but advanced specialists create value through standards decisions, procedure development, and signing responsibility, tasks for which AI cannot accept accountability. The occupation will concentrate around senior specialists + system operation.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: High exposure does not mean no opportunity. AI absorbs entry-level repetitive interpretation, while Level III specialists and technical leaders who understand standards, define procedures, and sign reports become scarcer. Advancing certification level and comprehensive judgment is the best hedge.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Nondestructive testing is a credential-driven industry. Study NDT, materials, or mechanical engineering and earn entry-level UT/RT credentials while in school. Make standards and field internships central rather than studying theory alone.

Learn AI radiograph interpretation, phased-array ultrasonics, and other new technologies while pursuing Level II and Level III certifications. Specialists who operate new equipment + understand standards + sign reports are the industry's scarcest combination.

The transition path is clear but requires patience. Earn an entry-level certificate, build field experience in an inspection-assistant role, and advance through certifications. In interviews, emphasize attention to detail and learning ability; credentials and field records are the strongest resume.

Do not use AI radiograph interpretation to reduce specialist staffing. Redirect people toward advanced interpretation and procedure development. Provide certified personnel with sensible career paths and safety protections; retention depends on level advancement and stable projects.

ai_s7_trends: AI radiograph interpretation and automated testing spread, reducing entry-level interpretation roles.
New technologies such as phased arrays and industrial CT expand inspection coverage.
Senior specialists and certified personnel remain in long-term shortage, making credentials highly valuable.

body: Nondestructive testing specialists use ultrasonics, radiography, magnetic particles, penetrants, eddy currents, and other NDT technologies to detect internal and surface defects without damaging materials or components, analyze data, assign quality grades, and issue inspection reports.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能在一堆底片里秒级标出疑似裂纹，但「这条显示到底是缺陷还是几何形状的正常反射」——这种要出报告、要签字的判断，还得靠检测师把探头再测一遍。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年无损检测专员在岗约 6.73 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 6.83 万人，净增约 0.10 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.57 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 7.74 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 正在改变无损检测，但方向是「辅助判读」而不是「替代检测师」：AI 自动评片能快速标出疑似缺陷，把检测师从疲劳的人眼判读里解放出来；但缺陷性质判断、工艺制定、标准适用和签字责任，仍然需要持证检测师。尤其复杂结构件和高温高压设备的检测，AI 漏判的风险决定了人必须兜底。

AI 缺陷分类模型辅助性质判断
工业 CT 实现构件内部三维检测
无人机与机器人搭载检测进入高危区域

ai_s3_list: 缺陷性质判断：AI 标出的可疑区，人确认是不是真缺陷。
工艺制定：不同材料、厚度、焊缝的标准适用。
签字责任：报告背后对设备与人身安全的判断。
复杂现场处置：高空、密闭、高温环境的检测应变。
标准与法规：行业标准迭代的持续学习。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业的「判读环节」正被 AI 大幅接管：自动评片和缺陷识别让低层级重复判断减少，但高级别检测师的价值在标准判断、工艺制定和签字责任上——这些恰恰是 AI 无法负责的。职业结构会向「高级检测师 + 系统运营」集中。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 高风险不等于没机会：AI 吃的是初级的重复判读，而 III 级检测师、技术负责人这种懂标准、能定工艺、敢签字的角色反而更稀缺。把证书等级和综合判断力往上提，就是最好的对冲。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 无损检测是「证书吃饭」的行业，建议读无损检测、材料或机械专业，在校就考取 UT/RT 初级证。把标准规范和现场实习当核心，别只学理论。
把 AI 评片、相控阵等新技术学起来，同时往 II 级、III 级证书冲。会操作新设备 + 懂标准 + 能签字的检测师，是行业最稀缺的组合。
转行路径清晰但要有耐心：先考初级证，从检测辅助岗位积累现场经验，再逐级考证。面试突出你的细致程度和学习能力，证书和现场记录是最好的简历。
别用 AI 评片去压检测师编制，把人力用在高级判读和工艺制定上。给持证人员配合理的职业路径和安全保障，检测行业留人靠的是等级晋升和稳定项目。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can automatically monitor roof separation and predict ground-pressure risks, but experienced underground workers still rely on drilling feel and intuition when the roof begins to creak.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 2,300 mining roof bolters were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to decline to 1,500 by 2034, a net loss of about 800 jobs, with about 100 openings annually. The median annual wage in 2026 is approximately $76,600 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace mining roof bolters, but it will change support methods. Automated bolting machines and roof-monitoring sensors are spreading, and work records and monitoring data are generated automatically. However, machines cannot replace on-site assessment of roof conditions, adaptation to complex conditions, or emergency response. Mines place greater value on support workers who interpret data and understand equipment.
ai_s2_accel: Wider use of automated roof bolters
ai_s3_list: On-site assessment of roof conditions: eyes and ears detect fractures, separation, and seepage.
Feel for drilling and support: experience controls inclination, depth, and anchoring force.
Adaptation to complex conditions: people adjust support for fractured roofs and fault zones.
Emergency and evacuation judgment: experience determines whether to evacuate when warning signs appear.
Equipment maintenance and site safety: people must monitor underground equipment.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 means automation is taking over records and monitoring. Systems handle data collection, scheduling, and documentation, but people still make on-site judgments about underground support.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean no change. Automated drilling and unmanned mining are advancing, reducing total underground staffing. However, roof safety is critical, making experienced workers who judge conditions, understand equipment, and respond to emergencies more valuable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Mining colleges and majors in mining or safety engineering provide the formal pathway into technical roles. Underground work is difficult and risky, so families should consider the decision carefully and workers must take safety training seriously.

Master automated bolters and monitoring systems and advance toward support crew leader or mining technician. Do not remain only an operator; learn roof and strata analysis and transition into technical work.

Mines hire for physical fitness and safety awareness, with mechanical experience an advantage. First obtain underground work certification and start as an assistant. State clearly on your resume that you accept underground work and describe your safety training.

Put safety training first when hiring, and evaluate responsibility and on-site judgment for support roles. Equip crews with ground-pressure monitoring systems to reduce dependence on experience while retaining veteran workers to mentor newcomers.

ai_s7_trends: Automated roof bolters and unmanned mining are reducing underground staffing and shifting support work toward equipment operation + monitoring judgment.
Tighter safety regulation is making ground-pressure monitoring and roof alerts standard, increasing demand for support workers who interpret data.
The industry is becoming larger-scale and greener, concentrating mining jobs in major mines and deep mining operations.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年矿山顶板锚杆工在岗约 0.23 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 0.15 万人，岗位净减约 0.08 万个，年均产生约 0.01 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 7.66 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代矿山顶板锚杆工，但会改变支护方式。自动化锚杆机、顶板监测传感器正普及，作业记录和监测数据自动生成；但顶板状况的现场判断、复杂工况的应变和应急处理，机器替代不了。会看数据、懂设备的支护工人，反而更受矿上重视。
ai_s2_accel: 支护方案 AI 辅助设计
ai_s2_auto: 顶板离层数据自动采集
ai_s3_list: 顶板状况的现场判断：裂隙、离层、渗水，靠眼睛和耳朵。
钻孔与支护的手感：倾角、深度、锚固力，靠经验把控。
复杂工况的应变：破碎顶板、断层带，支护方案要人调。
应急与撤离判断：征兆出现时，撤不撤人靠经验。
设备维护与现场安全：井下设备，保养靠人盯。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业的记录与监测环节正被自动化——数据采集、排程、记录都有系统代劳，但井下支护的现场判断还是人的。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于没变化。自动化钻机和无人化采掘在推进，井下人员总数会降；但顶板安全是矿上命门，会判断、懂设备、能应急的老工人，反而更值钱。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 矿业类院校采矿、安全工程专业是正规通道，毕业走技术岗。井下作业辛苦且风险高，入行前要全家想清楚，安全培训一定要认真学。
把自动化钻机和监测系统用熟，往支护班长、采矿技术员方向走。别只当操作工，学顶板岩层分析，向技术岗转型。
矿上招工看体能和安全意识，有机械经验加分。先考井下作业证，从辅助工做起；简历上写清楚能接受井下作业和安全培训经历。
招人要把安全培训放在第一位，支护岗位看责任心和现场判断力。给班组配好矿压监测系统，减少经验依赖，同时留住老工人传帮带。

ai_s7_trends: 自动化锚杆机与无人化采掘推进，井下作业人数减少，支护岗向「设备操作+监测判断」转型。
安全监管趋严，矿压监测与顶板预警成为标配，会看数据的支护工人更抢手。
行业向大型化、绿色化发展，矿业岗位向大型矿井和深部开采集中。

body: 矿山顶板锚杆工在井下巷道和采掘工作面操作锚杆钻机，通过钻孔、安装锚杆锚索和预应力张拉对巷道顶板进行支护加固，并监测顶板状态，防止顶板垮落事故。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can absorb much of the repetitive, structurable work of Water And Wastewater Treatment Plant And System Operators, but judgment, accountability, and interpersonal coordination still rest with people. What actually gets squeezed out is pure execution.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 132,400 water and wastewater treatment plant and system operators were employed in 2024, with employment projected to fall to 123,800 by 2034, a net loss of about 8,600 jobs. The occupation generates approximately 10,700 openings annually, and median annual pay was about $58,300 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace water and wastewater treatment plant and system operators, but it will reshape their workflows by assigning repetitive, structured tasks to tools while people focus on judgment, responsibility, and creativity. Formulaic execution faces the greatest pressure, while operators who understand real situations and make sound decisions become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: Use data profiles to accelerate operational and water-quality judgments.
Use simulations and scenario exercises to accelerate treatment-plan development.
Use retrieval tools to verify water-treatment resources and regulations.
Use collaboration tools to accelerate cross-team coordination in water treatment.
ai_s2_auto: Automatically generate structured water-treatment documents and reports.
Process and categorize repetitive water-treatment data.
Conduct rules-based preliminary screening and scheduling for treatment operations.
Search water-treatment knowledge bases and extract key points.
ai_s3_list: Professional judgment and tradeoffs in real water and wastewater treatment situations.
The ability to explain water-treatment expertise to nonexperts.
Accountability and final review in water and wastewater treatment.
Cross-boundary resource integration and interpersonal coordination in treatment operations.
Reuse of tacit knowledge from long-term water-treatment experience.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: Scoring rationale: AI can assist water and wastewater treatment operators, but professional judgment and final accountability are difficult to replace, resulting in 6/10 exposure.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Turn 6/10 into an advantage: let AI take the repetitive work, and spend your time on real projects, judgment, and people.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build strong water-treatment fundamentals and gain experience on real projects.
Connect prior experience to water-treatment operations and identify a differentiated entry point.
Turn water-treatment experience into products or management capabilities to increase leverage.
Use AI to eliminate repetitive treatment work and focus on decisions.

ai_s7_trends: First, collaboration between treatment operators and AI is becoming routine, making tool literacy a baseline requirement.
Second, high-value operational judgment and accountability are becoming scarcer.
Third, treatment-operator roles are evolving toward combinations of professional expertise and management or product skills.

body: Water and wastewater treatment plant and system operators monitor pump stations, reaction basins, and chemical-feed systems, adjust flow and dosing according to process curves, test water quality, and ensure treated water meets discharge standards.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Code completion can write routine code, but developers still choose reliable architectures, refine experiences, and decompose complex logic.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 86,000 web developers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 92,500 by 2034, a net increase of about 6,500 jobs, with approximately 5,400 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $90,900 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace web development, but it will accelerate routine work. Code completion and low-code tools take over simple pages, shifting developers from building pages to architectural judgment, experience refinement, complex business logic, and front-end/back-end integration. Pure design-to-code roles will be squeezed out, while developers with architecture skills become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Architecture decisions: people choose the technology.
Experience refinement: people judge the feel.
Complex logic: people decompose it.
Front-end/back-end integration: people align systems.
Requirement tradeoffs: people exercise judgment.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: An 8/10 rating means this occupation has high AI exposure. Completion handles routine work, but architecture and experience still require people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: High exposure does not mean high risk. Building simple pages from designs is being replaced, not front-end architecture roles. Developers who understand architecture and refine experiences become scarcer as productivity rises; simple-page-only developers face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build projects and framework skills. Pure design-to-code work is shrinking in the AI era, so develop architecture skills early.
Advance from building pages to architecture and experience ownership. Learn performance and security and seek responsibility for major modules.
Highlight shipped projects and specify the modules you owned. Employers value delivery ability.
Do not hire based only on coding ability. Assess architectural thinking. Core developers who can own modules deserve premium pay.

ai_s7_trends: As low-code tools spread, routine work shrinks.
Architecture and experience create opportunities.
Developers who can deliver are in greater demand.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年网页开发人员在岗约 8.60 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 9.25 万人，净增约 0.65 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.54 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 9.09 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代网页开发，但会提速常规环节。代码补全与低代码接管简单页面，开发从「写页面」挪向「架构判断、体验打磨、复杂业务与前后端联通」。真正被挤掉的是只做切图的人，有架构力的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 架构判断：选型靠人。
体验打磨：手感靠人。
复杂逻辑：拆解靠人。
前后端联通：对齐靠人。
需求取舍：判断靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 8/10 说明这个职业处在高 AI 曝光的开发区——补全吃常规，但架构与体验还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「切图写页」动作，不是「前端架构」的岗位。有架构力、能打磨体验的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只做简单页面的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 练作品和框架，AI 时代纯切图在缩，早点练架构。
从「写页面」升级成「做架构 + 管体验」，学性能与安全，争取大模块。
突出作品与上线项目，写清负责过哪些模块。企业看重能交付的人。
选人别只看会写，要看有没有架构脑子。能扛模块的骨干值得给高薪。

ai_s7_trends: 低代码普及，常规缩。
架构与体验带来机会。
能交付的更抢手。
